fields.statement: Verifier at 3c0b06a0 (fixer attempt 2, qa f1). Read the diff: gateAnswerCtx now opens the run worktree's own index (index.DefaultPath + openWriteIndex, memoised models) for the gate's reads and keeps c.IndexPath for the answer's write, falling back to the log when no index opens, as inboxGateRead does. go test -trimpath ./internal/tui/inboxapp/... passed, incl. TestGateFormScrollsLongQuestions, TestGateUnreadableQuestionShowsPositionNotHandle, TestGateAnswersEachThenResumes, TestGateBlankAnswerSendsNothing, TestGateAnswerFailureReopensOnRemaining, TestGateResumeFailureDetailScrolls, TestDetailPanelScrolls. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'Gate' passed (TestGateAnswerUsesWorktreeIndex, TestInboxGateQuestions{Budget,Kept,Unresolved}). In a scratch worktree with question.go reverted to 3c0b06a0~1, TestGateAnswerUsesWorktreeIndex fails ('decoded the full log 16 times'), so the test guards the fix.
